# CHANGES — prompt3: event-only Defined type reachability

## Verdict: reachable_types already handled event-only types correctly — NO FIX

### Trace
(a) Event names are reachability roots:
```
for e in &idl.events { reached.insert(e.name.clone()); }
```
So Event "Trade" inserts `"Trade"`.

(b) Transitive closure walks struct fields of reached names in `type_map()`:
```
let tm = idl.type_map();
// ...
if let TypeDefTy::Struct { fields } = &td.ty {
    collect_defined_refs(&f.ty, ...) → insert Defined names
}
```
`codama_convert::event_as_type_def` (and these in-code fixtures) place a TypeDef
named after the event into `types[]`. Once `"Trade"` is a root, `tm.get("Trade")`
yields the payload struct; a field `Defined("TradeDetail")` is inserted on the
next closure pass. No change to `reachable_types` was required.

`diff_events` only compares event disc/envelope metadata; layout changes ride
through `diff_types` gated by this reachability set — which is the correct split.

## Tests added
- `event_only_type_field_change_is_breaking` — Trade → TradeDetail.px U16→U32 → Breaking
- `truly_dead_type_change_is_cosmetic` — TradeDetail unreferenced → Cosmetic UNREACHED
